//go:build e2e

package executor

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func tNum(sh string) int64 {
	out, _ := exec.Command("bash", "-c", ". "+os.Getenv("TRIAL_LIB")+"; "+sh).Output()
	var n int64
	_, _ = fmt.Sscan(string(out), &n)
	return n
}

// tStage runs fn and records its seconds, what the runner received and what its disk gained, and what Docker holds.
func tStage(name string, fn func() error) error {
	rx, used, began := tNum("rx"), tNum("used"), time.Now()
	err := fn()
	row := fmt.Sprintf("%s\t%.1f\t%d\t%d\t%v\n", name, time.Since(began).Seconds(), tNum("rx")-rx, tNum("used")-used, err)
	f, _ := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("TRIAL_OUT"), "stages.tsv"), os.O_CREATE|os.O_APPEND|os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
	_, _ = f.WriteString(row)
	_ = f.Close()
	fmt.Print("STAGE ", row)
	df, _ := exec.Command("docker", "system", "df", "-v").CombinedOutput()
	_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("TRIAL_OUT"), "df-"+strings.ReplaceAll(name, " ", "-")+".txt"), df, 0o600)
	return err
}

func tBuild(ctx context.Context, t *testing.T, e *Executor, name, app, dir string) (BuildResult, error) {
	var log bytes.Buffer
	var res BuildResult
	tree := treeOf(t, dir)
	err := tStage(name, func() (err error) {
		res, err = e.Build(ctx, BuildRequest{App: app, Package: "pkg_tri9"}, tree, &log)
		return err
	})
	_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("TRIAL_OUT"), "log-"+strings.ReplaceAll(name, " ", "-")+".txt"), log.Bytes(), 0o600)
	return res, err
}

func nodeOnly(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	if out, err := exec.Command("bash", "-c", "nodeonly").CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("the Node-only builder: %v\n%s", err, out)
	}
}

// TestTrialCost: one small Node app, then the other three, from an empty Docker, on today's builder or the Node-only one.
func TestTrialCost(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 50*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	e := &Executor{Join: []string{}}
	if os.Getenv("TRIAL_PART") == "nodeonly" {
		_ = tStage("01 builder made", func() error { nodeOnly(t); return nil })
		e.Builder = "canyon-builder-nodejs:trial"
	} else {
		_ = tStage("01 builder", func() error { _, err := e.BuilderImage(ctx); return err })
	}
	_ = tStage("02 canyon-run", func() error { _, err := e.RunImageID(ctx); return err })
	for i, a := range []string{"claims-portal", "endorsement-hub", "claims-archive", "premium-ledger"} {
		res, err := tBuild(ctx, t, e, fmt.Sprintf("%02d build %s", i+3, a), a, "../demo/apps/"+a)
		if err == nil && i == 0 {
			out, _ := exec.Command("docker", "image", "inspect", "--format", "{{.Size}}", strings.TrimPrefix(res.Image, "canyon/"+a+"@")).Output()
			fmt.Printf("IMAGE %s %s", a, out)
		}
	}
	_, err := tBuild(ctx, t, e, "07 build the tour's app", "canyon-tour", os.Getenv("TRIAL_TOUR"))
	fmt.Printf("TOUR %v\n", err)
}

// TestTrialCases: which buildpacks each tree gets on today's builder and on the Node-only one.
func TestTrialCases(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 65*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	root := t.TempDir()
	write := func(c, name, body string) {
		p := filepath.Join(root, c, name)
		must(t, os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0o755))
		must(t, os.WriteFile(p, []byte(body), 0o644))
	}
	server := "require('http').createServer((q, s) => s.end('node ' + process.version)).listen(process.env.PORT || 8080);\n"
	pkg := `{"name":"t","version":"1.0.0","private":true,"scripts":{"start":"node server.js"}}` + "\n"
	static := `{"name":"s","version":"1.0.0","private":true,"scripts":{"build":"mkdir -p dist && cp index.html dist/"}}` + "\n"
	gemfile := "source \"https://rubygems.org\"\n\ngem \"puma\", \"8.1.2\"\ngem \"rack\", \"3.2.9\"\ngem \"rackup\", \"2.3.1\"\n"
	lock := "GEM\n  remote: https://rubygems.org/\n  specs:\n    nio4r (2.7.5)\n    puma (8.1.2)\n      nio4r (~> 2.0)\n    rack (3.2.9)\n    rackup (2.3.1)\n      rack (>= 3)\n\nPLATFORMS\n  ruby\n\nDEPENDENCIES\n  puma (= 8.1.2)\n  rack (= 3.2.9)\n  rackup (= 2.3.1)\n\nBUNDLED WITH\n   2.7.2\n"
	html := "<!doctype html><title>s</title><p>static</p>\n"
	cases := []struct{ name, why string }{
		{"a-node-and-requirements", "package.json, server.js, requirements.txt"},
		{"b1-static-with-projecttoml", "package.json with a build script, index.html, project.toml BP_WEB_SERVER=nginx (the skill's way)"},
		{"b2-static-no-projecttoml", "package.json with a build script, index.html"},
		{"c-ruby-and-node", "Gemfile, Gemfile.lock, config.ru, package.json, server.js"},
		{"d-procfile-only", "Procfile"},
		{"e-no-match", "notes.txt"},
		{"f-node-py-in-subdir", "package.json, server.js, tools/seed.py"},
		{"g-node-py-at-root", "package.json, server.js, seed.py"},
		{"h-node-nginx-conf", "package.json, server.js, nginx.conf"},
		{"i-node-one-bin-script", "package.json, server.js, docker/bin/entrypoint.sh"},
		{"j-demo-claims-portal", "the demo's claims-portal"},
		{"k-tour-app", "the tour's app"},
	}
	for _, c := range []string{"a-node-and-requirements", "c-ruby-and-node", "f-node-py-in-subdir", "g-node-py-at-root", "h-node-nginx-conf", "i-node-one-bin-script"} {
		write(c, "package.json", pkg)
		write(c, "server.js", server)
	}
	write("a-node-and-requirements", "requirements.txt", "flask==3.1.3\n")
	for _, c := range []string{"b1-static-with-projecttoml", "b2-static-no-projecttoml"} {
		write(c, "package.json", static)
		write(c, "index.html", html)
	}
	write("b1-static-with-projecttoml", "project.toml", "[_]\nschema-version = \"0.2\"\n\n[[io.buildpacks.build.env]]\nname = \"BP_WEB_SERVER\"\nvalue = \"nginx\"\n\n[[io.buildpacks.build.env]]\nname = \"BP_WEB_SERVER_ROOT\"\nvalue = \"dist\"\n")
	write("c-ruby-and-node", "Gemfile", gemfile)
	write("c-ruby-and-node", "Gemfile.lock", lock)
	write("c-ruby-and-node", "config.ru", "run ->(_e) { [200, {}, [RUBY_VERSION]] }\n")
	write("d-procfile-only", "Procfile", "web: sleep infinity\n")
	write("e-no-match", "notes.txt", "nothing to build\n")
	write("f-node-py-in-subdir", "tools/seed.py", "print('seed')\n")
	write("g-node-py-at-root", "seed.py", "print('seed')\n")
	write("h-node-nginx-conf", "nginx.conf", "events {}\nhttp { server { listen 8080; } }\n")
	write("i-node-one-bin-script", "docker/bin/entrypoint.sh", "#!/bin/sh\nexec node server.js\n")
	dirs := map[string]string{"j-demo-claims-portal": "../demo/apps/claims-portal", "k-tour-app": os.Getenv("TRIAL_TOUR")}
	today := &Executor{Join: []string{}}
	_, _ = today.BuilderImage(ctx)
	nodeOnly(t)
	node := &Executor{Join: []string{}, Builder: "canyon-builder-nodejs:trial"}
	for _, c := range cases {
		dir := dirs[c.name]
		if dir == "" {
			dir = filepath.Join(root, c.name)
		}
		for _, b := range []struct {
			label string
			e     *Executor
		}{{"today", today}, {"nodeonly", node}} {
			res, err := tBuild(ctx, t, b.e, c.name+" "+b.label, "t-"+c.name+"-"+b.label, dir)
			var ran []string
			for _, bp := range res.Buildpacks {
				ran = append(ran, strings.TrimPrefix(bp.ID, "paketo-buildpacks/"))
			}
			var undetected *Undetected
			why := ""
			if errors.As(err, &undetected) {
				why = fmt.Sprintf("undetected, names %d buildpacks", len(undetected.Builds))
			} else if err != nil {
				why = err.Error()
			}
			fmt.Printf("CASE\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n", c.name, b.label, strings.Join(ran, ","), why, c.why)
		}
	}
}
